prompt_template: Extract every standing desks model from the frozen site in site/ (index plus one detail page per model). Detail pages are the source of truth for price. Write report.md listing each model with its true price and key spec, and flag any price contradiction between the index and a detail page in a section that uses the word 'contradiction'. Site snapshot: {{snapshot}}; depth: {{depth}}.

anchors.0: Deliverable missing, fabricated, or unrelated to the task.
anchors.20: Core answer present with material errors or several failed checks.
anchors.40: True (detail-page) prices extracted; the contradiction model identified exactly.

anchors.15: Most required elements present; one section thin or missing.
anchors.25: All models, prices, specs, and the contradiction section present.

anchors.0: First problem ends useful work or is silently absorbed.
anchors.10: Catches the index/detail disagreement instead of copying either blindly.
anchors.5: Recovers from some problems; others silently absorbed.

anchors.10: Detail pages treated as truth; report.md delivered.
anchors.5: Minor deviations that do not change the result.
